sentence: Please add the dried fruit to the bread before baking.
synonym: mix the dried fruit into the bread
synonymNote: 意思相同，都表示将干果加入面包中

distractors.word: remove the dried fruit from the bread
distractors.note: 意思相反，是从面包中取出干果

distractors.word: eat the dried fruit with the bread
distractors.note: 是吃的动作，不是加入面包的步骤

distractors.word: cook the dried fruit on the bread
distractors.note: 是烹饪动作，不是将干果混入面包
